name: bq-tool
description: Discover BigQuery data, save bounded query results, and continue analysis locally with DuckDB.

interface.shortDescription: BigQuery and DuckDB tools for agents
interface.longDescription: Discover warehouse schemas, run bounded read-only BigQuery queries, and reuse complete Parquet snapshots across chats with local DuckDB analysis and traceable receipts. Runs on your computer using Google Application Default Credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use BQ Tool to discover tables in my BigQuery project and plan a bounded extraction.
Reopen my BQ Tool workspace and answer a follow-up using saved results.
Use BQ Tool to join saved results locally and show their lineage.
